newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran chops fingers of two thieves.
newsitem.headline: Iran chops fingers of two thieves.

text.p: Two convicted thieves were punished by having their fingers cut off in public in northern Iran, a newspaper said on Wednesday.

The daily Resalat said the amputations were carried out in a square in the Caspian Sea port city of Babol after the Supreme Court upheld the sentences passed by a lower court against the two convicted thieves.
In line with Iran's Islamic penal code, the four fingers of their right hands were cut off, leaving only the thumb, it added.
